flagged.title: Catholic Beliefs about God, Creation and Jesus
flagged.reason: The video instructs students to learn the incorrect Latin term 'creator ex nihilo' instead of the specification's required key concept 'creation ex nihilo', which would cost marks on specification concept questions.

mark_affecting.quote: If you're taking notes, definitely write this Latin term down, it's a big one: Creator ex nihilo.
